title: The 30th at Villa Saudade
place: Villa Saudade, a Portuguese-era villa in Assagao, North Goa
blurb: A pool, a DJ, a cake shaped like a unicorn startup, and twelve people who all want something from the birthday boy. The party never stopped. Someone's heart did.
